post.text: Kiwibank @KiwibankNZ Aug 21, 2022 Announced today, the Government has acquired 100% of Kiwibank, meaning we’ll remain 100% Kiwi owned. There’s no change for customers and we’ll continue to operate as an independent organisation with profits remaining here in NZ. kiwibank.co.nz Kiwibank looks to the future as Government confirms it will remain in public hands | News & updates Kiwibank today welcomed the news that it would remain in public ownership, with the Government announcing that it has acquired 100 percent of Kiwibank’s parent company Kiwi Group Holdings.
